text: Need a straight answer please. I'm minding my niece, she's 3 months old. Temp is 39.3. Her eczema has flared up badly over the last day, dry rough patches on her cheeks and the creases of her arms and legs, she's rubbing at them. But that's not what worries me. There are also little dark red-purple dots on her tummy and back that look different from the eczema. I pressed the side of a glass on them and they stayed exactly the same, they didn't fade. And her skin has gone a strange mottled look, sort of patchy and paler than normal, and around her mouth looks a bit greyish to me. She's not sleepy, she's wide awake, eyes open, watching me, wakes straight up if she does drop off. Her mum's on a night shift and can't be reached for a bit. Do I take her somewhere now or can it wait for a callback?
